method: All five inputs are whole numbers: attempts from 1 to 2,000, completions, touchdown passes and interceptions from 0 to 2,000, and passing yards from 0 to 100,000. Completions cannot exceed attempts, touchdown passes cannot exceed completions, and completions plus interceptions cannot exceed attempts, because an intercepted pass is an attempt that was not completed. The four NFL components are computed in double precision: a = 5 x (completions / attempts - 0.30); b = 0.25 x (yards / attempts - 3.0); c = 20 x (touchdowns / attempts); d = 2.375 - 25 x (interceptions / attempts). Each component is then clamped to the closed interval 0 to 2.375, so a completion rate below 30 percent scores zero and one above 77.5 percent hits the cap; the same bounds apply at 3.0 and 12.5 yards per attempt, an 11.875 percent touchdown rate and a 9.5 percent interception rate. The rating is (a + b + c + d) / 6 x 100, which makes 158.3 the maximum and 0 the minimum. The page reports the rating to one decimal place, each component to three decimals, completion and scoring percentages to one decimal and yards per attempt to two, all rounded half away from zero. Passing yards are net yards on the listed passes, and sacks are excluded from attempts. The statistic ignores dropped passes, opponent strength, era, weather, rushing and receiving contributions and two-point conversions; it is not a projection or a cross-league comparison, and NCAA or high-school ratings use different coefficients that this page does not compute. Everything runs in the browser with no storage, uploads or network access.

sources.title: NFL passer rating definition: four components each capped at 0 and 2.375, summed, divided by six and multiplied by 100 (Elias Sports Bureau statistic published by the NFL).
NFL passer rating components: 5 x (completion percentage - 0.30); 0.25 x (yards per attempt - 3.0); 20 x touchdown percentage; 2.375 - 25 x interception percentage.
A rating of 158.3 is perfect because all four components sit at their 2.375 cap, and the scale's minimum is 0.
